name: Lauren Fisher
body: I used to work at Baked Expectations and watch over Paul and his sibling’s growing up. Whether hanging in the Village. Going to Gaspee or an event in Providence  Paul was always in the mix with a smile on his face.  Edgewood was our stomping grounds and it connected us all. To the days of dancing at the Parlor and George’s. Paul was a kind soul who made you feel welcome and always lifted your Spirits.
